changelog:
p-image-ideogram 1.0.9 changelog:

- Expanded README and guidance on when and how to use `p-image-ideogram` vs. related skills
- Added detailed agent habits and default parameter settings for various use cases (thinking, upsampling, image size)
- Included tables comparing `p-image-ideogram` with `p-image`, and when to use each skill
- Provided explicit instructions for typesetting, structured layout (JSON caption), and vertical profiles
- Added fidelity checks and prompt-crafting rules to ensure faithful and controlled outputs
summary: Use when photo generation needs more control — photoreal results, text in the image, or structured JSON with hex colors and bounding boxes. Simpler photo generation, edits, and video use other skills in the suite.
